headline: Minister Šušnjar: Regulation on anchor prices to go to public consultation on Monday...
summary: Minister Šušnjar said a regulation on anchor prices will go to public consultation on Monday. He spoke after a government session, amid a planned protest by craft associations.
why: Price regulation for crafts affects small business margins and consumer prices, which matter for Croatian sector and inflation outlooks.
